def fmt(v):
    if v is None:

def set_cell(row_xml, ref, style, inner):
    """Replace empty cell <c ref=... s=.../> with populated cell, keeping order."""
    pat = re.compile(r'<c r="%s"( [^>/]*)?/>' % ref)
    new = '<c r="%s"%s>%s</c>' % (ref, style, inner)
    out, n = pat.subn(new, row_xml, count=1)
    if n != 1:
        raise RuntimeError('cell %s not found as empty self-closing' % ref)
    return out

def get_row(xml, r):
    m = re.search(r'(<row r="%d"[^>]*>)(.*?)(</row>)' % r, xml, re.S)
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError('row %d not found' % r)
    return m

# ---------- read sheet xmls from source zip ----------

sheets = {n: zin.read('xl/worksheets/' + n).decode('utf-8')
          for n in ['sheet3.xml', 'sheet6.xml', 'sheet7.xml', 'sheet8.xml']}

ct_xml = zin.read('[Content_Types].xml').decode('utf-8')

    body = m.group(2)
    for i in range(72):
        col = get_column_letter(9 + i)          # I..CB
        capcol = get_column_letter(21 + i)      # U..CN
        f = "'Capex and Debt Assumptions '!%s%d" % (capcol, src_row)
        body = set_cell(body, '%s%d' % (col, row), style,
                        '<f>%s</f><v>%s</v>' % (f, fmt(vals[i])))
    x = x[:m.start()] + m.group(1) + body + m.group(3) + x[m.end():]
sheets['sheet3.xml'] = x

# ---------- Assumptions - Line 01 (sheet8.xml): row 6, cols L..CE ----------
dist = [0.08, 0.095, 0.105, 0.095, 0.065, 0.07, 0.07, 0.07, 0.085, 0.09, 0.09, 0.085]

# ---------- Ratio Analysis (sheet6.xml): row 15 EBITDA Margin, cols C..H ----------

for i in range(6):

    body = set_cell(body, '%s15' % col, ' s="178"',
                    '<f>%s</f><v>%s</v>' % (f, fmt(ebitda_m[i])))
x = x[:m.start()] + m.group(1) + body + m.group(3) + x[m.end():]
sheets['sheet6.xml'] = x

# ---------- Working Capital (sheet7.xml): row 52 Total NWC, cols J..BV ----------

sheets['sheet7.xml'] = x

# ---------- workbook.xml: force full recalc on load ----------
if '<calcPr' in workbook_xml:
    workbook_xml = re.sub(r'<calcPr([^>]*?)/>',
                          lambda mm: '<calcPr%s fullCalcOnLoad="1"/>' % mm.group(1).rstrip(),
                          workbook_xml, count=1)
else:
    workbook_xml = workbook_xml.replace('</workbook>',
                                        '<calcPr calcId="191029" fullCalcOnLoad="1"/></workbook>')

# ---------- drop stale calcChain ----------
rels_xml = re.sub(r'<Relationship [^>]*calcChain[^>]*/>', '', rels_xml)
ct_xml = re.sub(r'<Override PartName="/xl/calcChain\.xml"[^>]*/>', '', ct_xml)

def style_from(ws, src_coord, tgt_cell):

    tgt_cell._style = copy(src._style)

# ---------------- Income Statement ----------------

MONTH_C0, MONTH_C1 = 9, 80   # I .. CB  (Jan-23 .. Dec-28)

# EBITDA Margin (row 55)

    cell = ws.cell(55, c)
    if cell.value is None:
        L = get_column_letter(c)
        cell.value = f'={L}54/{L}$6'
        style_from(ws, 'P55', cell)

# Net Income Margin (row 69)

    if cell.value is None:
        L = get_column_letter(c)
        cell.value = f'={L}68/{L}$6'

# Tax (row 66): flat 30%, nil when PBT negative

        L = get_column_letter(c)
        cell.value = f"=IF({L}64<0,0,{L}64*'Assumptions - Company Level'!$C$8)"
        style_from(ws, 'I66', cell)

# ---------------- Working Capital ----------------

WC_C0, WC_C1 = 10, 74        # J .. BV (Aug-23 .. Dec-28)
for c in range(WC_C0, WC_C1 + 1):
    L = get_column_letter(c)
    # Inventory (row 46)

    cell.value = f'={L}44+{L}45'

    style_from(wc, f'{L}50', cell)

         '+($K$14*(1+{g})/({r}-{g}))/(1+{r})^$K$18')

# Table 1 : Equity NPV vs Cases (rows 28-31) x Cost of Equity (row 27, D:I)

    for c in range(4, 10):              # D..I
        L = get_column_letter(c)

# Table 4 : Equity IRR vs Terminal Growth (rows 50-54) x Cost of Equity (row 49, D:I)

        dcf[coord] = ArrayFormula(coord, IRR_F.format(r=f'{L}$49', g=f'$C{r}'))

# ---------------- Dashboard : combo chart (bar Revenue + line EBITDA %) ----------------
dash = wb['Dashboard']

data = Reference(dash, min_col=1, min_row=4, max_col=7, max_row=4)  # A4:G4 (title + EBITDA %)

def recalc(path, tag):

def irr_of(re_, g):
    """IRR (consecutive periods 0..8) of the recomputed discounted FCFE row."""
    flows = list(r14)
    flows[8] = r14[8] + r14[8] * (1 + g) / (re_ - g)          # terminal value at growth g
    disc = [f / ((1 + re_) ** t) for f, t in zip(flows, r18)]  # discount at cost of equity
    def f(q):
        return sum(v / (1 + q) ** i for i, v in enumerate(disc))
    lo, hi = -0.999999, 10.0
    flo = f(lo)
    for _ in range(200):
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
        fm = f(mid)
        if flo * fm <= 0:
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo, flo = mid, fm
    return (lo + hi) / 2

def to_serial(v):
    if isinstance(v, datetime.datetime):
        return (v - EPOCH).total_seconds() / 86400.0
    if isinstance(v, datetime.date):
        return (datetime.datetime.combine(v, datetime.time()) - EPOCH).total_seconds() / 86400.0
    return v

import zipfile
from lxml import etree
NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
RNS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(OUT)
names = zin.namelist()
wbxml = etree.fromstring(zin.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
rels = etree.fromstring(zin.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
relmap = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels}
sheetmap = {}
for sh in wbxml.find(f'{{{NS}}}sheets'):
    tgt = relmap[sh.get(f'{{{RNS}}}id')]
    if not tgt.startswith('xl/'):
        tgt = 'xl/' + tgt.lstrip('/')
    sheetmap[tgt] = sh.get('name')

def fmt_num(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return '1' if v else '0'
    if isinstance(v, float) and v == int(v) and abs(v) < 1e15:
        return str(int(v))
    return repr(v)

content = {}
for tgt, name in sheetmap.items():
    data = zin.read(tgt)
    root = etree.fromstring(data)
    vals = wbv[name]
    n = 0
    for cell in root.iter(f'{{{NS}}}c'):
        f_el = cell.find(f'{{{NS}}}f')
        if f_el is None:
            continue
        coord = cell.get('r')
        v = vals[coord].value
        if v is None or v == '':
            continue
        v = to_serial(v)
        for old in cell.findall(f'{{{NS}}}v'):
            cell.remove(old)
        ve = etree.SubElement(cell, f'{{{NS}}}v')
        if isinstance(v, bool):
            cell.set('t', 'b'); ve.text = '1' if v else '0'
        elif isinstance(v, (int, float)):
            if 't' in cell.attrib: del cell.attrib['t']

        else:
            s = str(v)
            if s.startswith('#'):
                cell.set('t', 'e')
            else:
                cell.set('t', 'str')
            ve.text = s
        n += 1
    content[tgt] = etree.tostring(root, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8', standalone=True)
    print(f'cached values injected in {name}: {n}')

zin.close()
os.replace(OUT + '.tmp', OUT)
print('final saved', OUT)
